messages:
rafa (Peregrine SI): Opening thread - HealthNet onsite cluster failing GPU init after private image install. Need architecture review + quick escalation.
mel (partnerships): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the failing systemd logs and node status? Is this a provisioning or post-upgrade issue?
rafa (Peregrine SI): Post-upgrade. Node boots but kubelet shows CrashLoopBackOff for our inference runtime. Systemd shows driver probe failures. Excerpt: `kernel: nvidia: probe failed, -ENODEV` and `containerd: error mounting /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu: version mismatch`.
tariq (solutions): Which GPU model and driver versions? Also which private image tag are you using?
eva (HealthNet): GPUs are XG-RTX4 (firmware v2.3). Private image tag: private-infer:v2026-02. Customer can't change base OS; it's locked to kernel 5.10.83 due to compliance.
zoe (eng-runtime): Kernel 5.10 likely needs older driver stack. Our shipped runtime bundles libcudart built for 535.x drivers. Two paths: (A) run image with host-driver passthrough disabled and force a CPU-only runtime to keep pods running; or (B) build a runtime variant linked against older CUDA ABI and test against their host libs.
diego (eng-platform): For option A I can push a quick helm override to disable nvidia-device-plugin and set REDWOOD_ACCEL=cpu. This is fast but performance will degrade.
liz (support): I'll prepare a KB for the CPU-fallback pattern so SI and customer know the exact helm values and implications for performance and cost.
rafa (Peregrine SI): Customer absolutely needs GPU for nightly batch scoring. CPU fallback won't meet their SLO. They have a maintenance freeze for 10 days.
tariq (solutions): OK escalation plan: 1) immediate mitigation: CPU fallback so CI/smoke tests pass; 2) triage with eng-runtime for compat build; 3) engage HW vendor for driver backport or firmware that can work with newer driver.
eva (HealthNet): HW vendor already said backporting may be possible but would require signed firmware, takes time.
zoe (eng-runtime): Pre-meeting ask: Peregrine please upload host /lib/modules and `dmesg` + `modinfo nvidia` output. I need exact symbol versions. Also include `readelf -s /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 | head -n 20` from the node.
rafa (Peregrine SI): Uploading artifacts to our secure share: https://share.peregrine.example/healthnet/node-06-hosts.tgz (contains /lib/modules, rpm/dbgsym, dmesg, and container logs).
infra-bot: [deploy] private-infer:v2026-02 rollout: node-06 crash detected, 2/4 pods restart within 5m.
mel (partnerships): Let's schedule a quick architecture huddle 30 mins from now. Can eng-runtime + eng-platform join? Need solutions and Peregrine too.
zoe (eng-runtime): I can join.
diego (eng-platform): I'll be there.
tariq (solutions): Same.
rafa (Peregrine SI): Confirmed. I'll bring SI runbook and vendor contact.
liz (support): I'll document the temporary helm patch snippet: ```yaml
nvidia:
  enabled: false
env:
  REDWOOD_ACCEL: cpu
```
mel (partnerships): Meeting agenda: 1) quick summary + artifacts (5m); 2) mitigation rollout (10m); 3) compatibility engineering plan (20m); 4) vendor engagement plan and partner escalation (10m).
eva (HealthNet): Please include our security contact as well for the private image changes.
zoe (eng-runtime): After artifacts review, if ABI mismatch is the issue we can attempt a compat-tag runtime. I expect a triage decision within 24h; prototype within 48-72h depending on symbol differences. If it's more invasive, we'll propose temporary hosted migration as an alternative.
mel (partnerships): Partnerships escalation rule: if eng-runtime ETA > 72h, partnerships will brief leadership and propose options (hosted migration, temporary dedicated quota, or negotiate customer patch window).
tariq (solutions): Post-meeting tasks: 1) Peregrine runs CPU-fallback cluster-wide and reports health checks; 2) eng-runtime to run local tests against the host tarball; 3) partnerships to loop in HW vendor PM for backport feasibility.
rafa (Peregrine SI): Running CPU patch after call. Will report back once nightly batch passes on CPU.
infra-bot: [ticket] created RN-2044 for eng-runtime compatibility investigation.
liz (support): I'll draft a KB and send to Peregrine for review before publishing.
zoe (eng-runtime): One more ask: Peregrine, include `uname -r`, `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`, and `ldconfig -p | grep libcudart` outputs in the artifact.
rafa (Peregrine SI): Added those files. uname shows 5.10.83, /proc/driver shows driver 470.141.03, libcudart points to 10.2.
mel (partnerships): Great. See you all in 30. We'll keep this thread for action updates. :spiral_note_pad:
rafa (Peregrine SI): Thanks team — appreciate the fast ramp.
